reviews.text: Going here was such a traumatic experience. Dr. Pelllon completely botched a cat euthanasia. It took two hours and TWICE she said the cat had passed and as we said our goodbyes we saw that the cat was still breathing. TWICE. My elderly neighbor passed away and this was his beloved cat who was extremely ill with kidney disease. My neighbor’s dear friend made the difficult decision to put her best friend’s cat (whom she’d also loved for 17 years) down after two torturous months of watching her wither. I came with her to be supportive. I tried to talk her out of going to Park la Brea Vet because I had  already had issues with just simple check ups for my cats there. Dr. Pelion mixed up the weights of my cats and was about to administer the wrong dosage.  She also didn’t administer all the vax shots I had asked for and now I have to go through the process all over again. She also just seemed really spacey. The front desk said one thing- She said another. Just so confusing. Anyway, despite my warning about this place, my neighbor and friend was overwhelmed and just wanted to go to the nearest vet so we ended up there. Honestly it was a nightmare. We waited so long under bright lights and a hard table just for Dr. Pellon to come and ask weird random questions about an emaciated cat about to be put down l- ”What does she like to eat?” It was as though she was doing a health visit. At one point I asked if she understood we were putting the cat down. They took this sweet cat in the back saying they would put in the catheter and bring her right back to administer sedation. It took half an hour and the assistant rushed her in all floppy and said “The sedatives are already working!” So we didn’t even get a chance to say a proper good bye. Then came the multiple false deaths. TWICE Dr Pellon put her stethoscope on the cat and said there was no heartbeat. But the cat was still breathing. It took two hours total. My friend is also elderly with health issues and she was a wreck afterwards. Just sobbing and holding her chest. It’s just such a heart breaking experience.. I will say I came to this vet about 4 yrs ago. There was a different doctor there. And they gave me half off shots for six kittens I had rescued and was fostering. Some of the front desk folks are helpful. But this sealed the deal- never never again with this place. It’s already such a hard thing to have to do. This experience will haunt both of us. And our sweet little girl deserved better

I have never in my life written a one star review for any place. But the care I just received here was rude bordering on incompetent. My cat has been in an emergency all day and I had to rush him to an ER where I spent $2K for an xray,  bloodwork, and hydrating him, where they identified an obstruction (probably from eating something weird). The vet there recommended I could keep him there for the day (an additional $3K), take him immediately into surgery (which she felt would be rushed, and likely unpleasant for him, and that it was best to wait and do more imaging later), or take him to a local vet for monitoring. I decided to take him to the local vet (this place). The vet at Park La Brea arrived about 40 minutes late to the waiting room for our appointment at 10:30 and was extremely rude, dismissive and generally uninformed on my cat’s situation. Her advice was basically “Well if there is an obstruction u shud operate and we don’t really do that here”, which plainly contradicted the ER vet and which she didn’t really support with any rationale (indeed, she didn’t even see the X ray images themselves). The consensus that I thought I reached with her was to perform further imaging later in the day and to send the initial x-ray scans from the ER. Then the nurse comes back into the room and tells me the plan is to “give him fluids only”. No follow up, no further planning. Seriously I am not one to complain - this was staggeringly incompetent and sloppy for a professional. At this point I don’t trust this place to take my cat back to, and I won’t coordinate care with them further, so I’m left to scramble on next steps and probably take my cat back to ER.

I adopted my dog Hudson in 2020 like a lot of us, he is my first and only dog and I’m sure you know where this is going….he’s more than my best friend he’s my soul dog. There was a day where my fiancée and I were awoken by Hudson having a seizure, where he had 4 more in the span of 3-4 hours. A nightmare. He was put on anti seizure meds and was on them every day for almost 2 years. It wasn’t until we moved to LA and had an appt with Dr. Rattan that the question was asked, does he still need this medicine every day? Our old vet was happy to take thousands of dollars a year from us for his meds without ever asking this question. It was then that we slowly took Hudson of his medicine and I can report 2 years later he’s had zero seizures. Dr. Rattan gave us an emergency supply of his medicine and a plan in case anything were to happen, and it was this combination of care for my dog AND care for my wallet that made me a lifelong patient of Dr. Rattan. He has a very gentle touch with Hudson and you can just tell he GETS it!! Keep this wonderful doctor and practice busy and successful please!!

This place does not provide throughout examinations, seems to lack urgency, and has poor communication. Not to mention the lack of guidance. I was not given very detailed instructions about how to properly care for my dog after our visit, what signs to watch for, or what I should do if my dog's condition got worse. When your pet is sick or has an infection, you want to leave the vet feeling confident that you know exactly what to do, and ! did not feel that way. If you love your dog stay away from this place. DO NOT RECOMMEND

Part of why I chose Park La Brea Vet was Dr.Rattan’s (Dr.R)experience with sighthounds, who require specific knowledge regarding bloodwork&anesthesia. Unfortunately, my last 2 experiences at PLB were with Dr.Pellon(Dr.P), who I found to lack basic bedside manner.
Approximately 5 weeks ago, my dog’s tail was stuck in our front door while leaving for a walk. I brought her to PLB&reported using SuperClot&medical-grade Manuka honey on the wound. Dr.P initially attempted to send us home with ointment. I advocated for shaving her tail to see exactly where to apply it. She returned&stated, “she needs it amputated.” When I asked about recovery time, visits, medications,&cost, she responded, “I’ll have a vettech come in to explain that.” As the vet, I expected her to know this information. I also stated I would not allow Dr.P to perform the surgery,&staff assured me Dr.R would. At the final recovery visit, when her stitches were removed, the vettech brought her out&said, “here you go.” I had to ask about precautions after removal. The tech said, “oh just Neosporin until it stops bleeding,” without explaining how long bleeding was expected or what would be abnormal. On Monday, I returned to PLB because my dog was more tired than usual, intermittently coughing, breathing heavier than normal,&licking her catheter site from surgery 5 weeks prior. Dr.P said her breathing&heart sounded normal but recommended bloodwork&x-rays. After palpating her iliopsoas, my dog arched her back, potentially because the palpation was startling or uncomfortable,&Dr.P stated, “it might be pancreatitis,” despite her symptoms not fitting pancreatitis. There was confusion whether bloodwork would be in-house or sentout. Dr.P said it would be in-house. After the x-rays, a vettech returned my dog&said, “you’re good to go. Dr.P just wants your dog to go home with ointment for her catheter site.” I received no explanation from the Dr. regarding potential differential diagnoses. I was given conflicting information about when bloodwork would return—one tech said tomorrow, another said today,&the receptionist initially said tomorrow. I had to repeatedly follow up throughout the afternoon. The receptionist was thorough following up&forwarded information as it became available. At 7PM, Dr.P finally updated me, stating, “looks like she has masses on her lungs I’ll send you oncology recommendations.” Those recommendations were never sent. When I asked how much time she suspected my dog had, I was told oncology would tell me. No medication was provided to keep her comfortable,&I had to advocate for Vetprofen to help with inflammation. I requested Dr.R call me for a 2nd opinion because of his sighthound expertise. Instead, I was told I could text my questions to him. He ultimately told me I could seek a 2nd opinion elsewhere&return to PLB for medication. After requesting my dog’s records be sent to another hospital, I received a copy. As a healthcare professional, I understand the importance of accurate, ethical documentation. I was extremely concerned to see documentation that didn’t accurately reflect what occurred. Regarding the tail incident, Dr.P documented: “Tissue necrosis – trauma vs infection vs ischemia vs neoplasia vs other,” as well as a plan of care. This discussion did not occur as documented. During the recent visit, despite respiratory concerns, her respiratory rate was not documented. The assessment states: “ASSESSMENT-
Coughing-chronic bronchitis vs pneumonia vs neoplasia vs infectious tracheobronchitis vs other
-Pruritus-local irritation vs bacterial dermatitis vs pain vs anxiety vs other
PLAN
-Discussed with O findings, potential Ddx.
-Discuss next steps after radiologist report.”
This doesn’t reflect my experience. I was sent home with cream without the Dr. discussing these differential diagnoses.
Finally, my dog was due for a dental, yet the documentation states: “Oral–Stage periodontal disease. Teeth&gingiva normal, no fractures or lesions noted.” So is it periodontal disease or normal teeth&gingiva?
Overall, avoid Park La Brea Vet at all costs

Big shout out to Chelsea in the Front Office who recently sent me all of my Kisa's medical records which I needed as we made a major move this summer and resettled in another country. She treated my request kindly and without hesitation and within a short while I had everything I needed! Well done ...  we will miss the fabulous customer service we always received here and wish them all the very best!

I took my pup here because it's so close to us and the great reviews. We left feeling kind of 'meh,' about the whole experience. While we got the basics of what we needed (vaccine and heartworm prevention), the whole interaction with all three staff members lacked the warm and friendly welcome I've experienced elsewhere. There was no acknowledgement of the concerns I listed in the appointment notes, just a curt, "You look like you have questions."

I have been taking my dog to La Brea Vet care for years and have had nothing but great experiences. EVERYONE there is so kind and very helpful. They never rush through appointments and take time to genuinely answer my questions and concerns.

Truly a fantastic vet! My 8 lb 8 yr. old chihuahua needed her annual wellness checkup, a vaccine, and a nail trim. After doing some research, I decided to schedule an appointment with Park La Brea, who were able to see me almost immediately.

Doctor S. was so professional, patient, and attentive to both me and my puppy. She took the time to answer my silly questions, explain things thoroughly, and printed out materials and resources for me, as well. She even caught an ear infection that my dog has had for years, despite me specifically asking other vets if the build up in her ear was normal, none even bothered to test it. They diagnosed it on the spot and provided me with the medicine.

Jacob also took really great care of my tiny doggy. Typically, she really doesn’t like having her nails cut and others have had a hard time taking care of her abnormal dewclaw, but he did a really fantastic job. He was so careful and gentle with her the entire time.

So happy to have found this gem, I feel so relieved knowing that I can entrust the care of my precious puppy to such a great team.

Update 7/8/2026: We returned for vaccine update, nail trim, and to address some excessive itching and paw licking Tiny Tina has recently been experiencing.

Dr. Rattan was so kind, so invested, and so careful with my little dog. He listened and considered everything I had to say, asking me numerous questions to help understand and identify any possible causes for Tina’s itchiness. After a thorough check of her heart, lungs, fur, paws, etc. He slowly and clearly explained the possible causes and available remedies and treatment management. He considered my concerns and even provided me with a great little education on new scientific developments on the cause and chemistry behind these skin conditions, and their potential impact in the fields of cancer and auto immune disease treatment. Never the less, he provided me with several options, respected my decision to attempt to manage it with simple at-home first and to return if no relief was achieved. Nail trim was smooth and quick.

As always, just a wonderful experience and a phenomenal service. It is so rare to receive this degree of genuinely kind care and attention, which makes me so grateful to have found such a wonderful vet for my Tiny Tina!

I really love everyone at Park LaBrea.  My dogs just go in for normal check ups and vaccinations and it's easy to get an appointment and everyone is very helpful at the front desk.  The vet and vet tech's are great. They are very sweet and caring

The team at Park La Brea Vet is so kind, quick to respond, and helpful. I had a pleasant experience – from the initial inquiry, to the front desk, to the vet tech/care team. The facilities are clean, and Dr. Rattan was great – he helped address my pet's concerns with care and explained everything to us in detail. Would return back!
Wonderful Vet!
Great team all around from receptionists to doctors. Wouldn't trust anyone else with my pups! Never overcharge me too. Highly reccommend

I have waited a very long time to leave this review but I must.

I went there worried about my dog having some warts and some other symptoms and was treated pretty much like when a woman goes to the doctor and is dismissed and told it’s nothing.

They said they could remove the warts for $3k. Nothing else.

I decided to take my dog to another vet who instead of presenting me a big bill, said the first thing would be labs. To see whats going on.

The labs came back and it turns out my dog had very very high cholesterol.     Normal for dogs is 3. My dog had 10. Had I paid 3k for surgery he maybe would have not made it.

Before any surgical treatment to remove the warts the other vet said to tweak his diet immediately, add supplements. Cut cheese. Cut treats.

With the other vet advice my senior dog’s health turned around in 30 days. He recovered his energy. He stopped snoring. He stopped hiding all the time and wants to play again. He is loving again. They even checked for Cushings. All of this at a really affordable price.

This was my experience.

I just moved to this area and was nervous about finding a new vet and to my surprise I was very pleased with the vet here! The staff was very kind and efficient. The vet tech was incredibly patient and non-pushy about all the services that were recommended. I didn’t feel rushed when the doctor was looking at my cat and bloodwork etc didn’t take long at all! Glad I’ve found a new and caring place for my cat.

Plb vet is the best!! We used to live at park la Brea which is why we started going there, but stayed with them even after moving because they’re amazing! They are so kind, accommodating, and incredible at their jobs. I would give shoutouts but then I’d have to list every single employee because they are all incredible. Appreciate them so much.

For more than 25 years, Park La Brea Veterinary Care has provided exceptional, compassionate care for my pets, and I couldn’t be more grateful. The entire team is knowledgeable, attentive, and genuinely invested in the health and well-being of every animal they treat. They take the time to explain options, answer questions thoroughly, and make both pets and owners feel comfortable and supported. It’s rare to find a practice that combines such professionalism with true warmth and heart. I trust them completely and highly recommend Park La Brea Veterinary Care to anyone looking for outstanding veterinary care.

Awesome experience, I was able to get my dog scheduled and examined with all the appropriate documentation to travel. No hassle at all to leave/return, and I will definitely be using them moving forward.

Dr. Rattan and his staff was awesome. Knowledgeable, reasonable prices, honest and straightforward. Doesn't try and sell you a million different products/services.

Would go back just for him and his staff.

Ty Dr. Rattan
Dr. Rattan has been great with helping to diagnose my cat for her urinary issues. Also, very upfront about the costs of treatments/procedures when discussing recommended needs for your pet.

Been coming here for the last year and a half.  The staff is excellent and the vets and vet techs address all of my concerns when I bring my three dogs in.  They make each experience a positive one and are easy to communicate with. Maybe most importantly, I  didn’t feel nudged toward any expensive treatments or procedures. Their pricing is fair. Would highly recommend for anyone who is a pet lover.

Excellent!!!! It's never easy taking my cat to the Vet but they always make "Sonita" feel safe and secure. From the 1st phone call, front desk staff and thorough visit. We saw Dr Pellon yesterday who was absolutely the BEST! She really took her time examining Sonita and talking to me about any concerns I may have. Sonita got her annual vaccines, nails trimmed and they shaved a matted area of the fur.
So happy I found my go-to vet to take care of my little buddy!!

I really enjoyed my vet visit. Everyone was so nice and caring towards my animal and I. I have had some bad experiences at other vets but this visit was far from that. Everyone handled my cat Frida was such love and respect. I could really feel the passion from the team about the work that they do. I overall had a great experience and really loved everyone I met! Thank you for taking such good care of my cat!

EDIT: I recently lost my sweet boy (I had to take him to an Emergency Vet on a Sunday). I called Park La Brea the following Monday to explain and ask that this be updated in the system so I don’t get any more automated reminders for care. A few days ago, I got a condolence card in the mail with the sweetest note and wildflower seed paper to plant. It was so unexpected and it truly touched my heart. I’m grateful for this place, even with the passing of my boy.

————————————————————————

I had a great experience at Park La Brea. We were able to get in on Monday and the vet saw us right away. They were able to treat my kitty and he is now doing so much better.

As an update, I had to go back because my kitty was sick again, but it was a great experience again. They were able to quickly see my kitty and offered a solid solution. The people at the front desk were very kind - one of them even helped me bring the food I bought out to my car.
Everyone is nice and caring. My cat feels comfortable and calm whenever we are there. No complaints!

I’ve been bringing my pets to Dr. Rattan and his wonderful staff for many years, and I can’t say enough great things about the care they provide. Dr. Rattan is incredibly responsive—especially when I need answers quickly—and his team is always kind, attentive, and professional. I can be pretty demanding at times, but I always feel reassured knowing my beloved pets are in such capable and compassionate hands. Francois Pierre and I say thank you Dr. Rattan.

Everyone at Park La Brea Vet Care is extremely nice and welcoming. My dogs and cat are actually quite calm when they visit. They have excellent treatment and am happy that I have found a great local vets office.

my 8 year old lab is hitting that age where he’s getting bumps. just moved nearby and took him here for a checkup and then removal of one of the suspicious bumps (others were ok to leave). surgery went well and he’s home recovering now!

Very patient with my one cat who is a little testy.  Also, good service from the front desk to the vet tech to the doctor. Kept me informed of the test results and suggested solutions where appropriate.
Excellent care.
The staff is welcoming & kind, and I trust the veterinarians with giving my animals the best care!
They saved my dogs life.
Staff is always helpful and answers my questions.

Everyone from the front desk to the vet techs to Dr. Rattan are great, they're kind, patient and have done right by my boys, Meatball and Cooper. Service is convenient, fairly priced and the ability to get answers via text for minor questions is fantastic. Very happy to bring my boys here, thank you!
Great all around. I trust Dr. Rattan.
Best Veterinary care in LA!

I stopped going to this vet after my dog passed away. I’d like to leave a review as a precaution to other pet owners and their lovable pets. I brought my 13 year old girl in for a yearly checkup. I was told she was fine paid the fee and left. This was about mid December. 2 weeks later she became very ill and could not stand anymore nor walk. I took her into the emergency in the middle of the night as she began coughing and having difficulty breathing. The ER doctor told me she had a huge mass on her belly that erupted and was causing internal bleeding. He diagnosed her by feeling her stomach and without expensive testing. Unfortunately my angel had to be put to rest that night. I called this vet office about 2 days later and asked for notes related to her last visit. The notes explicitly had a section for her abdomen and indicated she was fine, the same with her eyes. I know her eyes were not fine as they stated as she had cataracts  and  was loosing eyesight. I called after reviewing the notes and asked to speak to someone as to why she was never diagnosed for the abdomen issue during her checkup. The receptionist stated he would have someone call me back. Since then I’ve heard nothing. This is the only way that I have to share my experience to someone who will listen as they obviously did not .i also want other little angels to have better care than my baby did. I think about her everyday and I feel down on myself for not getting her proper care..

I sadly have to change my review from 5 to ZERO (0/5 stars) since this experience.  Poor management.  Paid $160 for grooming a small dog , I didn’t ask for a buzz cut, eye was bleeding and nails not cut.  Tried to up charge me for a med dog when my dog is under 20lbs. Until I made a fuss they charged me reg price which in total still was outrageous price of $160.  My dogs chart says hostile dog for 4 paragraphs.  He’s a small fufu dog.  Administrated drugs to keep pup calm - additional charge -  They went against my wishes. Of course he’s not calm if you poke him in eye.   Had him 5 hours.  This pup lives with a child and is friendly to the 2yo’s on block as well as an elders up the street. Hence why I want him Fluffy.  Plus he itches without some Fur.   It’s a preference.  I understand most like short.  My dog doesn’t like short hair and it’s irritating for him and when I cut I have to get meds for itching. A loop.   He has curly hair so he naturally looks messy. Sorry but I want his natural hair.   And I know the groomer excuse is going to be “his hair was very matted”. No. This is not true. It’s his natural hair. Big difference.  You can tell from other low reviews this is something they say often to unsatisfied clients.
Zero reference of biting a human ever.  He doesn’t like this vet/ for obvious reason.   I asked to speak to owner of vet - he said no. I was extremely upset with my experience.

My dog, Jackson, has been scratching and licking himself to a point where his hair is gone in the affected areas. After trying various products that didn't work, I brought him in and Dr.Ruttan suggested something I hadn't tried. It started working after the first couple doses. Almost a week has passed and Jackson is still itch free and his hair is starting to grow back. We are both very relieved and thrilled. So yes, I highly recommend Park La Brea Vetrinary Care.

We have had Park La Brea Vet as our vet for a few years. They are incredible. I’ve seen all the vets and they all take their time to care about and for my little ones. The staff is phenomenal handling my babies with love. I’ve been to other vets and PLBV are by far superior. They have the resources, the knowledge, the doctors, staff, love, and kindness taking great care of my fur family.

I LOVE this office. I am a bare bones pet owner, I let my dog be a dog, I prefer wholistic or minimal medical intervention and each vet and vet technician at this office is always open to helping me balance science and nature based treatments for my dog. They are so loving and thoughtful and knowledgeable. My dog is 4 now and he is healthy and happy thanks to the team in this office.
This place is great and always takes very good care of my dog.

Snow my young energetic (Husky) had a serious injury to her leg where I honestly didnt know if she was going to make it, or heal without complications of infection to her wounds. The staff from the front desk to the medical team always take the time to asses her injuries, give me instruction on the next steps, and encourage me to stick to treatment plan the doctor has laid out. I can truly say that their work and care saved my dogs life and leg. I couldn’t be more appreciative of the entire team. Even when I felt discouraged about her progress, they always encourage me to stick to the treatment plan and she is getting stronger everyday. If you want a team who really cares about your fury family, this is where you should go.

This place was so kind and professional with me during my recent dogs passing. She meant the world to me and finding a place that I could afford was super hard/depressing. Park la brea vet made the process a lot easier on me. I highly recommend them.
Excellent teeth cleaning service w/anasthesia for my cat at a reasonable cost. I recommend Dr Rattan and his vet clinic. Staff is also very good.

After going to different veterinary clinics over last 20 years, I can finally say that I’ve found the best one ever. Incredible staff, amazing service and reasonably priced. Jason Rattan assisted me with my dog yesterday and I was blown away by his knowledge and care. You’ve earned a client for life for my family’s animals. Thank you for everything!

I’m so thankful to Dr. Andrew Marshall and his team for seeing my dog, Chicken, on short notice. As the relief veterinarian, Dr. Marshall provided exceptional care, taking the time to listen to my concerns and performing a thorough exam that earned my trust. He explained the treatment plan clearly and never made the appointment feel rushed. The front desk staff and vet tech were also incredibly kind and welcoming. I highly recommend Park La Brea Veterinary Care.
I love them!!! So kind and easy to get appointments with.
Was charged nearly $400 to be told my pets were fine and vaccination fees were not disclosed up front. Friendly staff but not remotely worth the price
Great office and looking forward to bringing my Chanel for all of her future appts!

I can’t say enough good things about Park La Brea Veterinary, from the friendliness of the staff to the caring of their doctors. Everyone exuded an equal measure of compassion and professionalism. And if this wasn’t enough, their pricing was a lot more affordable than any other veterinary office around.

I live in the neighborhood and take my two kitties here. They always answer the phone, they always fit you in same day if you need it, and they always listen when you ask them the same question a thousand times (sorry!). So glad to have found Park La Brea Vet.
The quality of care for my dog has been top notch and the staff is responsive and friendly, both on the phone and in person.  Highly recommended.
Dr. Rattan and his staff are very considerate.  We had to put our cat to sleep and they were respectful and kind.  We will take our other cat there if needed
The staff at Park LA  Brea Vet are very caring and always friendly and helpful!
They do a great job
Love their customer service and quick replies! Recommended!

Cons:

-Butchered my puppy's ears to the point of infection during a grooming section. Awfully inadequate, and even after the bloody session was over for my puppy, they charged us in full and we were left with having to buy prescription medication from them to heal his sudden pain and infection, which they had created!

-Several days later we asked for a refund and they gave it saying don't come back. Highly unprofessional.

- My dog was traumatized for a week afterwards, but we soon found relief with another vet.

Pros:
-Front desk staff
-I don't have to go there anymore!
